# Generated -- do not edit

Everything under this directory is produced by
[openapi-python-client](https://github.com/openapi-generators/openapi-python-client)
from `openapi/openapi.yaml`. A hand-edit here is silently overwritten the
next time the client is regenerated (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `hack/fetch-spec.sh`,
`.github/workflows/regenerate.yml`).

The hand-written layer -- auth injection, retry, typed errors, pagination --
lives one directory up, in `pipeline_analytics/*.py`.
